description: Transforms a documented PRD into a complete, explainable, validated software architecture. Produces both human-readable (.md, .docx) and machine-readable (JSON) artifacts.

changelog.summary: Phase 5: Implemented release-gate.js (G-001 through G-010, 10/10 PASS), execution-metadata-logger.js (start/complete/list §61 compliance), metrics-report.js (§66 periodic metrics), RELEASE-POLICY.md (branching, roles, rollback, deviation, incident procedures), and CI pipeline (.github/workflows/ci.yml). Release gate APPROVED on first full run. Closes GAP-011 through GAP-014.
changelog.compatibility_impact: Additive. No existing skill sections modified.
changelog.approver: Sushma S — Skill Owner / Architecture Lead

changelog.summary: Phase 4: Implemented verify.js (V-001–V-010 artifact verifier), architecture.schema.json (JSON Schema for §46 output), 8 test fixtures (T-001, T-004 through T-010), and run-verification-tests.js regression runner. Result: 8/8 fixtures pass. V-001 through V-010 all execute. Closes GAP-005, GAP-006, GAP-007, GAP-008.
changelog.compatibility_impact: Additive. No existing skill sections modified. Phase 4 tooling validates existing artifact format.

changelog.summary: Phase 3: Implemented deterministic tier routing, validated tier overrides, seven Tier 1/2/3 fixtures, a repeatable routing test runner, and a live Tier 3 routing record for the Service Desk PRD index. Added routing evidence fields to §§41, 59, and 61.
changelog.compatibility_impact: Additive. Tier selection is now recorded as evidence; existing depth-calibration guidance remains in place.

changelog.summary: Phase 2: Added Source Index Contract to §60 (formal JSON schema for requirement inventory + source hash record + integrity rules + tooling reference). Implemented phase2/index_prd.js (PRD indexer + source hash generator, 601 requirements extracted from Service Desk PRD) and phase2/stale-source-detect.js (stale source / hash mismatch detector). Closes GAP-009.
changelog.compatibility_impact: Additive. §60 gains the Source Index Contract subsection and tooling reference. No existing sections removed or renamed.

changelog.summary: Added enterprise operating model (§57–§67), deterministic tier routing (§59), automated verification rules (§62), test/regression suite categories (§63), failure recovery (§64), human review and approval rules (§65), monitoring and metrics (§66), enterprise release checklist (§67), and Phase 1 baseline establishment (§68).
changelog.compatibility_impact: Additive. No existing architecture output fields were removed or renamed.

changelog.summary: Initial enterprise skill specification. Core PRD-to-architecture design, traceability, validation, and downstream handoff.
